summary: A draft US-Iran peace agreement circulated through diplomatic channels this week, lifting equities to record highs as investors looked past macro warning signs. At the same time, Dell's blowout AI server earnings drove a tech-led surge, with the S&P 500 logging its ninth straight winning week.
tweet: A US-Iran peace draft and Dell's AI earnings blowout pushed stocks to all-time highs, while oil fell ~5% on ceasefire hopes — but sticky energy-driven inflation keeps bonds and gold on the back foot. --- Final output...
